description:
AC3 oracle references src/commands/post-merge.ts, but the defaultCloseIssueFn/defaultAbandonIssueFn/defaultDemoteIssueFn actually live in src/release/post-merge.ts. The oracle passes trivially because a non-existent path also yields empty git-diff output; a future edit to the real file would not be caught. Point the oracle at the correct path.
